scope.matching: In-memory exact current endpoint and key comparisons; no credential bytes, hashes, prefixes or paths persisted.

credential_transport.helius_mcp: Current process arguments contain neither the key nor credential flags; pinned local configuration supplies credentials through environment configuration.
credential_transport.senses_launchagents: Path-only launch configuration; the endpoint is loaded in-process from the private configuration file.

limitations: This is a delta scan of saved files modified since the prior broad saved-history scan; it does not replace that earlier scan.
Remote conversation/tool-service storage, provider-side logs, inaccessible backups and Time Machine are outside local visibility.
Absence from scanned local sources does not retract prior process-list or session-transcript exposure.
